title: Mixing: Rock Show, Love In Song, Treat Her Gently/Lonely Old People, Crossroads by Wings | 1975
content:
Studio 3, Wally Heider Recording, Los Angeles
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Alan O’Duffy

The final mixing session for Wings’ fourth album Venus And Mars took place on 27 March 1975.

Stereo mixes of four songs were made: ‘Rock Show’, ‘Love In Song’, ‘Treat Her Gently – Lonely Old People’, and ‘Crossroads’.

After this there was a final session in which the master mixes were compiled and crossfades assembled.
